description: Scaling runs before deferred weight and scale reads complete.
trigger: A file-backed ordinary linear with a present, shape-compatible scale tensor is loaded with mt_fread and deferred_mode enabled, using dtypes already accepted by the loader.
expected_behavior: Multiply populated weight blocks by populated scales and retain that result.
actual_behavior: Both get_tensor calls can return allocated placeholders. The helper immediately multiplies them, while end_deferred_load later copies the unscaled transposed weight into the destination, overwriting the operation.

verification.description: Inspected Linear.load, recursive Module.load, Model._load_single and _load_autosplit, and both model_diff load sequences. They place module loading between begin_deferred_load and end_deferred_load. Unsliced linears permit deferral; sliced linears normally disable it through can_defer_load.
verification.limits: Source ordering only; no asynchronous loader or tensor operation was executed.
